description: Role access toolkit with Assign/Revoke, Copy Roles, and User Access Diff.

subOperations.title: Assign / Revoke
subOperations.description: Find a user by email or personnel code and assign or revoke one or more role IDs. Role selection is first-row safe: the chooser filter checkbox is isolated from row checkboxes, and role checkbox state is applied without toggle-style double clicks.

inputs.name: userIdentifier
inputs.label: Email or personnel code
inputs.help: Email is detected by @; a numeric value is treated as personnel code.

inputs.name: roleIds
inputs.label: Role IDs
inputs.validationMessage: Enter one or more numeric role IDs separated by spaces.
inputs.help: Separate multiple role IDs with spaces.

inputs.name: inputFile
inputs.label: Excel file
inputs.help: Column A: email/personnel code. Column B: space-separated role IDs. Header row is optional.

clientProcessor.description: Batch controller runs in the extension background runtime so switching tabs or minimizing the Operations Toolkit does not stop the job.

subOperations.title: Copy Roles
subOperations.description: Copy all roles from a source user to a target user. Supports single copy or an Excel batch. In Excel mode use column A for source user and column B for target personnel code.

inputs.name: targetUserIdentifier
inputs.label: Target personnel code (User B)
inputs.validationMessage: Target user must be a numeric personnel code.
inputs.help: Excel batch uses the same rule for User B so it can run through the stable Host batch processor.

inputs.name: copyInputFile
inputs.label: Excel file
inputs.help: Column A: source email/personnel code. Column B: target personnel code. Header row is optional.

clientProcessor.description: Remote-only Excel batch reuse of the stable background processor. User B is a personnel code in batch mode.

subOperations.successMessage: Roles copied from User A to User B.
